entries.10803cd3aacc4116: A general contractor whose core business is construction contracting for buildings and civil engineering works, and which also buys, sells and leases real estate and handles design and supervision of construction work.

entries.a81bd0a3acdf8581: The foundation consists of shrine and temple construction techniques inherited since its founding in 1586, and the credibility built up over a long history. Among the internal environment the company cites are its shrine and temple construction techniques, as well as a corporate culture of frugality, solidity and steadiness, and a sound financial position. Besides its head office, its branches are located in Tokyo, Tohoku, Hokuriku, Nagoya, Osaka and Kyushu, and it has a structure for undertaking work nationwide.
entries.b5032202985fb059: Construction contracting and real estate business, etc.
entries.ba6352140dbf33f8: The construction business is the core of sales. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥94,470 million for the construction business and ¥1,567 million for the real estate business, etc., and the MD&A states that the construction business accounted for 98.4% of net sales. Employees (as of March 31, 2026) are also mostly in the construction business at 726, with 10 in the real estate business, etc., and 35 in company-wide common functions. All sales are domestic, and there are no net sales to overseas external customers.
